stopRules: Only one matched no-fault screening pair at 4 operations/second is authorized; stop for review after two runs.
Stop immediately for invalid evidence, safety/correctness failure, controller/cleanup failure, changed provenance or competing containers.
Queue patterns and latency are descriptive; no stable flag, automatic capacity bound, repeat, higher rate, confirmation or fault trial.
Pause only at a complete matched pair with verified cleanup/restoration; pair completion cannot resume into more work.
Two hours is the cumulative safety ceiling, not a finish-time estimate. Preserve historical evidence and v1 launch hold.
